note: Drawn by hand for this proof of concept. In the real app each point carries the evidence behind it.
sentence: I am more sure than I was this morning, because the checks now judge the running app rather than the source.

points.why: Four promises written, none checked against anything.
The first check ran and found two real problems.
The check that judges the running app went red; the app was ahead of its promise.
Red resolved. The record of what is kept was seeded and re-derived twice.
Every piece of work derived from the promises landed or was honestly disposed.
New ground: your experience decisions are not promises yet, so nothing checks them.
The shape of the app is running and can be seen; the promises are being written against something real.
